tasks.title: CRITICAL: HeroShader Canvas-Nesting beheben
tasks.body: HeroShader.tsx startet eigenen \u003cCanvas\u003e innerhalb des Haupt-Canvas in Scene.tsx. R3F erlaubt kein verschachteltes Canvas. Fix: HeroShaderContent als normale Mesh im Haupt-Canvas rendern, kein separater Canvas. Dateien: src/components/HeroShader.tsx, src/components/Scene.tsx

tasks.title: CRITICAL: GLTF Dispose + useGLTF.setDecoderPath fixen
tasks.body: 1) useGLTF.setDecoderPath('/draco/') läuft auf Modul-Level in ProductModel.tsx → muss in useEffect. 2) useGLTF(modelPath) gibt scene zurück aber keine Dispose-Cleanup → GPU Memory Leak. Fix: scene.traverse + dispose in useEffect cleanup. Dateien: src/components/ProductModel.tsx

tasks.title: CRITICAL: Navigation-Links reparieren

tasks.result: Fixed: changed section id in ArtifactsSection.tsx line 133

tasks.title: HIGH: CustomCursor MutationObserver Leak fixen
tasks.body: MutationObserver rescannt bei JEDER DOM-Änderung alle a, button, [data-cursor-hover] Elemente und hängt neue Event-Listener. Bei lazy-loaded Content → exponentielle Anhäufung. Fix: Event Delegation auf document.body statt Einzel-Listener. Dateien: src/components/CustomCursor.tsx

tasks.title: HIGH: Hero-Shader Maus-tracking vereinheitlichen
tasks.body: MouseTracker in Scene.tsx setzt uniform-Werte direkt, aber HeroShader.tsx hat eigenes Tracking-System. Beide kollidieren → Maus reagiert nicht oder zuckt. Fix: Einheitliches Tracking-System wählen und redundantes entfernen. Dateien: src/components/Scene.tsx, src/components/HeroShader.tsx

tasks.title: HIGH: Error Boundary für 3D Canvas
tasks.body: Scene crasht → ganze Seite wird weiß. Fix: React ErrorBoundary um \u003cCanvas\u003e wrappen, Fallback-UI bei WebGL-Fehler. Dateien: src/components/Scene.tsx, neu: src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx

tasks.title: DEFACT: FLUX2 Hero-Shot API-Workflow erstellen (Tower)
tasks.body:
**Goal:** Create and validate a working FLUX2 text-to-image API workflow for DEFACT hero product shots on the Tower-PC ComfyUI instance.

**Context:**
- Tower: http://192.168.178.84:8188
- Model available: `flux2_dev_fp8mixed.safetensors` (~33 GB)
- Pitfall: FLUX2 requires `DualCLIPLoader` + `CLIPTextEncodeFlux` (not plain `CLIPTextEncode`)
- Pitfall: CheckpointLoaderSimple on FLUX2 may return CLIP=None — use separate loaders

**Deliverables:**
1. API-format workflow JSON: `workflows/flux2_hero_tower.json`
2. Test script: submit to Tower and download output
3. Verify 1024×1024 output renders correctly

**Prompt template to use:**
> "3D-printed ritual object, polished chrome surface, clinical studio lighting, white void background, archival photograph, high detail, minimalist composition"

**Success criteria:**
- POST /prompt returns prompt_id
- GET /history/{prompt_id} returns completed status
- Output PNG downloads successfully to Mac

**Design system:** Background should match `#F0F0F0` (void white), object chrome/silver.

tasks.title: DEFACT: Asset-Sync-Script erstellen (Tower → Next.js)
tasks.body:
**Goal:** Build a Python script that generates DEFACT assets on Tower and syncs them to the Mac project directory.

**Requirements:**
1. Connect to Tower ComfyUI (http://192.168.178.84:8188)
2. Submit workflow requests for different asset categories
3. Poll completion via REST API
4. Download outputs to Mac via HTTP (`/api/view`) or rsync
5. Convert PNG → WebP (Sharp or cwebp)
6. Save to: `public/assets/comfy/{hero,textures,backgrounds,motion}/`
7. Generate manifest JSON with metadata (seed, prompt, resolution)

**Technology:**
- Python 3 with `requests` (HTTP) + `Pillow` / `webp` (conversion)
- Works from Mac terminal (no SSH tunnel needed, direct API)

**Output:**
- `scripts/comfy_tower_sync.py` — main generation + sync script
- `scripts/asset_manifest.json` — generated asset registry

**Design constraint:** All assets must align with DEFACT's Clinical Archive aesthetic.

tasks.title: DEFACT: Material-Texturen + Background-Workflows
tasks.body:
**Goal:** Create workflow + pipeline for tileable material textures and generative backgrounds for DEFACT.

**Asset types needed:**
1. **Seamless Brushed Aluminum** — 512×512 tileable texture for 3D shaders
2. **Archival Paper Grain** — 1344×768 subtle grain background for page sections
3. **Clinical Grey Noise** — 512×512 tileable noise for overlay effects

**Requirements:**
- FLUX2 txt2img with prompt tuning for tileability
- Post-processing: Pillow to check seamless tiling, resize, WebP export
- Each texture gets: raw PNG + tileable WebP + 2× scale variant

**Prompt templates:**
> "Seamless brushed aluminum texture, industrial precision, high resolution, tileable, grayscale"
> "Subtle grainy archival paper texture, off-white #F0F0F0, faint noise, no objects, background-only"

**Deliverables:**
- `workflows/flux2_texture.json` — API workflow
- 3 texture sets downloaded to `public/assets/comfy/textures/`
- Tileability verification report
tasks.result: 3 texture sets complete: brushed_aluminum (tileable), clinical_noise (tileable), archival_paper (background).
